blocks.text: MANILA – The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has completed its search of the passenger cabins and crew areas of the fire-gutted MV June Aster off Coron, Palawan, and directed the vessel’s operator to hire a salvor for further recovery operations. The salvor will undertake the next phase of recovery efforts aboard the vessel. In a statement on Monday, PCG spokesperson Commodore Noemie Cayabyab said response teams have fully accessed and searched the bridge, crew accommodation, economy passenger accommodation and air-conditioned passenger accommodation areas of the vessel. “These areas have been 100 percent penetrated by our response teams.
